meta.note: gold.* and oracle.* are hidden from the systems (run_eval passes only id, request_text and as_of)

cases.request_text: Two of us from LaGuardia to Chicago, August 20-23, budget $1,200. No flights before 9am please. Keep 1-3pm free for a nap every day. Parks and museums.
Me and my husband, flying in from LaGuardia, Chicago from the 5th to the 8th of June. We'd rather be close to downtown than save money. Up to $1,300. Food and art.
Family of 3 from Los Angeles to NYC Nov 1 to Nov 4, max $1,600. No bars. The zoo, the aquarium and the classic sights.

Coming from Los Angeles to NYC leaving Thursday, August 25 and flying home Sunday, August 28 - it's me and two friends. We don't do early starts, nothing before 10 please, and we want good food near where we sleep. $2,300 cap. Shows at night would be great.
Hi! Two of us flying from Dallas to Chicago, May 22-25. Max budget $2,900 for flights and lodging. We love museums and good food. No flights before 9am please.

Me, my husband and our two little ones (4 and 6) want to see Chicago leaving Tuesday, August 9 and flying home Friday, August 12, coming from Miami. Our youngest still naps after lunch, so early afternoon until about three is hotel time. Parks, the zoo, kid stuff, nothing rushed. We'd like to keep it under $3,100 all in.
Solo trip to Chicago from JFK, Jul 8 to Jul 11. Budget $900. I want jazz, comedy and live music. Nothing before 11am - I'll be out late, so plan evenings until 11pm.

My partner and I are heading to Chicago from Newark September 26-29, $1,510 tops. We'd like to land early and fly back late so we don't waste the first and last day - but being able to step out the door into the Loop matters more to us than flight times or saving a few bucks. Big sights and deep-dish.
Three friends from JFK, Chicago August 5-8. We'll rent a car. Budget 3.9k. Food, bars and the lakefront - no museums at all, we don't care for them.
I'm taking my mom to Chicago from LaGuardia, from the 18th to the 21st of July; $1,200 total. She gets around in a wheelchair these days. She loves art and the lakefront.
We are two travelers from San Francisco to Chicago, Sep 5 to Sep 8, budget $1,600. We pray at midday, please keep 12:30-14:00 free every day. Interested in history, museums and the famous sights.

Foodie couple from JFK, Chicago leaving Friday, August 26 and flying home Monday, August 29. We're vegetarian, and after dinner we like to stroll back to the apartment, so dinners should be a short walk from where we stay. Around $2,500, a gallery or two too.
Chicago August 30 - September 2 from Miami, 2 adults, $1,500 max. My knee is bad: no walking more than 10 minutes at a time. Museums and a show.

Looking for something cheap but nice in Chicago for the two of us, from the 8th to the 11th of September, from Los Angeles. We absolutely can't go over $2,400. I'm useless before my coffee, so no flights at the crack of dawn - nothing that leaves before 8.

Two adults from O'Hare to New York, October 19-22. Budget $1,340. We want nonstop flights and a central place to stay; if we can't have both, location matters more than price and flights. Broadway and museums.
We're a family of four (two kids under 5) visiting NYC from Los Angeles Aug 14 to Aug 17. The kids nap 1 to 3 every afternoon, and we're usually done by 6 pm. Max $3,500. Playgrounds, parks, animals.
Just me, from Denver to New York August 29 - September 1, $1,500 budget. No flights before 10am. Galleries, museums, shopping and good coffee.
Three of us coming from O'Hare to Manhattan, from the 23rd to the 26th of August. We've had enough of museums for a lifetime - we want parks, food and the big landmarks instead. Keep it under $1,500.
Two of us from O'Hare, New York Aug 8 to Aug 11, max $1,500. We'll rent a car. We'd love the zoo and a couple of big parks.

Honeymoon in New York, leaving Sunday, September 4 and flying home Wednesday, September 7, flying from Dallas. We're not morning people at all, and we want dinners within walking distance of our hotel. Food and a show or two. $1,200 is the ceiling.
Two adults from Dallas to NYC September 1-4. Budget $1,400. It must be nonstop - I hate connections. Museums and food.

Students on a tight budget, three of us from Miami, New York Jul 8 to Jul 11. Hard cap $1,600 - honestly whatever is cheapest that works, even if we sleep far out. Nightlife and cheap eats, we want to cram in a lot.
Two seniors from Dallas visiting New York September 16-19. We rest every day from 2pm to 4pm, and we can't walk more than 15 minutes. Museums and a Broadway show. Budget $1,100.

My wife is in a wheelchair and keeps kosher; we're coming from Denver to New York leaving Tuesday, August 16 and flying home Friday, August 19 with about $1,400 to spend. History and culture are our thing.
